seedHelp: Write this code down. The cantor types it when opening the room so these boards can be checked.
boards: Boards printed: {n} (each with a 6-character check code)
steps: Hand out the boards and beans to mark the cards.
In the app, choose Ser cantor and enter this print seed.
Call the cards. Whoever completes a pattern says: Lotería!
To check a paper board, press L and type the 6-character code at its foot.
